slides.h: STOCK IS NOT AN ASSET UNTIL IT [[MOVES]]
slides.dek: Why a full shelf can be the most expensive thing in your business.

body: Every rupee sitting in unsold stock is a rupee that cannot buy more of the product that IS selling.
Dead stock does not just sit there. It blocks the winner behind it.
Running out of a winner costs you a week of sales. Overbuying a loser can cost you the whole season's cash. Only one of these mistakes is survivable twice.
Ask how many days of sales each carton represents. Thirty days is inventory. A hundred and eighty days is an interest-free loan you gave your supplier.

slides.h: THE FIRST MARKDOWN IS THE CHEAPEST
body: Stock that missed its moment loses value every week you protect its price. Selling the mistake fast frees cash for the next good decision.

slides.h: WHAT IS THE OLDEST CARTON IN YOUR STOCK ROOM?
slides.body: Go look at the date on it. Then tell us in the comments how long it has been waiting.
